module: Node "Random Vector" (repeat_instant, casino icon). Provides a non-normalized random vector. Inputs: xMin/xMax, yMin/yMax, zMin/zMax (default -1 and 1). Output: vector ({x, y, z}).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

work.desc: Draws each component uniformly between its min and max and writes {x, y, z}.
